7.5 Error Detection
[SWS_Ocu_00018] ⌈The detection of development errors is configurable (ON / OFF)
at pre-compile time. The switch OcuDevErrorDetectApi shall activate or deactivate the
detection of all development errors.⌋(SRS_BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00386)
[SWS_Ocu_00019] ⌈If the switch OcuDevErrorDetectApi is enabled, then API parame-
ter checking is enabled. The detailed description of the detected errors can be found in
chapter Error classification and chapter API specification.⌋(SRS_BSW_00386, SRS_-
BSW_00369, SRS_BSW_00339)
[SWS_Ocu_00020] ⌈The detection of production errors cannot be switched off.⌋
(SRS_BSW_00339)
